comments.why-root-deps: Two packages are pinned here purely to control npm's hoisting across the web and native workspaces. Neither is used by the root itself.
comments.tailwindcss: The web app needs v4 and the native app needs v3 for NativeWind. Claiming the root for v4 means the hoisted @tailwindcss/postcss resolves v4, and v3 nests under apps/native. Without this npm gives the root slot to v3 and the web build fails in globals.css.
comments.next: eslint-config-next hoists to the root but next nests under apps/web, so the config cannot resolve next/dist/compiled/babel/eslint-parser and linting dies. Keeping next at the root fixes resolution. Must stay in step with the version in apps/web.
